answer: The summit chain is verified at intake and walnut publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a comet checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 20 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
